# Requirements Quality Checklist: Open-source foundation, CI and contributor experience

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate on completeness, testability, security, privacy and performance budget of the 001 requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all governance documents named with their required content (CoC version, CONTRIBUTING topics, SECURITY scope)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is every CI job that `ci-gate` aggregates enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK003 Are the release artifacts (platforms, image, SBOM, signatures, provenance) fully listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are all Makefile targets that contributors rely on named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity and Testability

- [x] CHK005 Is the `ci-gate` pass/fail rule stated precisely enough to write a unit test (including skip semantics)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is the expected version output of the binary specified exactly? [Testability, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Is "works without Homebrew" defined by the prerequisites a Linux contributor needs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Is the sign-off rule explicit about merge commits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]

## Security

- [x] CHK009 Is fork-safety (no secrets for required jobs) stated as a requirement with a scenario? [Security, Spec §US2 AS3]
- [x] CHK010 Are least-privilege permissions, SHA pinning, concurrency and timeouts required for every workflow? [Security, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK011 Does the scanning requirement cover vulnerabilities, secrets and misconfiguration with a failure threshold? [Security, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK012 Are the security policy's scope classes, private channel and response times specified? [Security, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK013 Is release signing required to be keyless (no stored long-lived keys)? [Security, Assumptions]

## Privacy

- [x] CHK014 Do issue forms require a warning against pasting prompts, keys or personal data? [Privacy, Spec §FR-002]

## Performance Budget

- [x] CHK015 Is there a measurable bound on local setup-and-verify time? [Performance, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK016 Is there a measurable bound on CI feedback time? [Performance, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK017 Is a micro-benchmark entry point required for later hot-path work? [Performance, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK018 Is the dependency on the repository being public (badges, Scorecard, dependency review) recorded? [Assumption]
- [x] CHK019 Is the blocked remote verification (PROGRESS blocker B1) acknowledged in the spec? [Assumption]

  FR-014, SC-006) before ticking.
